additional_accepted_risks.risk: Intermittent OBS desktop automatic SRT reconnect failure (Windows timeout, macOS zero-byte listener)
additional_accepted_risks.decision: Owner accepted proceeding to merge with the unexplained reconnect timeout recorded as a residual risk.
additional_accepted_risks.observation: A new reference listener accepted OBS's reconnection, received no data for its 5 second receive timeout and ended with 0 bytes; OBS logged nothing further.
additional_accepted_risks.related_correction: becfc32 flushes the OBS MPEG-TS I/O context before freeing its URL context (use-after-free confirmed by AddressSanitizer). Not established as the cause.
additional_accepted_risks.diagnostic: The Windows reference receiver records RECEIVE_END with byte count, socket state and SRT error.
additional_accepted_risks.scope: Only this OBS desktop reconnect fixture failure on Windows and macOS. It is not a waiver of either OBS desktop job.
additional_accepted_risks.mechanism: A failed OBS MPEG-TS writer leaves queued packets behind; the next writer starts before the muxer header is written and passes a stale packet to an uninitialized FFmpeg muxer, which calls a null function pointer. Sampled on macOS in run 43313241961 and reproduced natively in FFmpeg. That a stale packet was queued in either hosted failure is inferred, not observed.
additional_accepted_risks.correction: f5948a4 frees the previous writer's queue before the next start, in the version-locked OBS lifecycle correction.
